detail:
- **Documented**: 4 of 4 modules carry an author's summary

3 requirements: 3 checked.
label: runtime
quotes: The client module is the browser-side entry point that hydrates island components into the DOM, bridging rendered markup to React at runtime.
The React module provides the react declaration, serving as the integration point exposing the React library within the project.
Islands is the client-server registry module that maps island component IDs to implementations and encodes or revives their props so server-rendered islands can be hydrated on the client.
The Server module renders island components on the server into HTML with their props and slots serialized for client-side hydration.
